description: Agent-native Philippine Stock Exchange CLI — quotes, filings, and a local price history no free API serves.

tools.name: companies_directory
tools.description: One page of the full listed-company directory (name, symbol, cmpy_id, security_id). Optional: page (default: 1).

params.name: page
params.description: Directory page number (about 50 companies per page)

tools.name: companies_lookup
tools.description: Search companies by name or symbol prefix (first 20 alphabetical matches only — use exact-match filtering). Required: query. Returns array of CompanyMatch.

params.name: query
params.description: Company name or ticker symbol prefix

tools.name: companies_profile
tools.description: Company profile page: sector, subsector, incorporation, auditor. Required: company-id. Optional: security-id.

params.name: company-id
params.description: PSE Edge company ID (from resolve or the directory)

params.name: security-id
params.description: Security ID for multi-class listings (from the directory)

tools.name: disclosures_document
tools.description: Full disclosure document content as server-rendered HTML (use this, never the broken downloadFile.do PDF path). Required: file-id.

params.name: file-id
params.description: Document file ID from the disclosure viewer

tools.name: disclosures_search
tools.description: Search disclosures by company, template, and date range (server-side; the keyword parameter is IGNORED upstream — use the filings command for client-side keyword filtering). Upstream expects a form-urlencoded body, not JSON. Optional: company-id, keyword, template (plus 2 more).

params.name: company-id
params.description: PSE Edge company ID (empty searches all companies)

params.name: template
params.description: Disclosure template name filter (e.g. Quarterly Report)

tools.name: disclosures_view
tools.description: Disclosure viewer wrapper for one filing. Required: edge-no.

tools.name: financials_report
tools.description: Balance-sheet and income-statement summary tables for a company (server-rendered HTML; authoritative when the PDF download is broken). Required: company-id.

tools.name: market_composite
tools.description: Composite/sector page: PSEi and sector indices, market summary (volume, value, trades, advances/declines/unchanged), embedded daily PSEi series since 2021. HTML-entity-encoded JSON uses single-encoded " — decode before parsing. Page is ~1.5MB.

tools.name: prices_history
tools.description: Daily OHLC and value-traded history for one security (first-party JSON). Required: company-id, security-id, start-date, end-date. Returns the new ChartData.

params.name: security-id
params.description: Security ID (from the directory; required for correct series)

tools.name: prices_snapshot
tools.description: Current-session stock data page: last price, change, OHLC, volume, value, market cap. Required: company-id. Optional: security-id.

params.name: security-id
params.description: Security ID for multi-class listings (GTCAP-class companies need this)

tools.name: quotes_get
tools.description: EOD quote for one ticker: close, percent change, volume. as_of is a synthetic midnight stamp — it carries no trade-time information; derive the trading date from the session calendar. Required: symbol. Returns the PhisixQuote.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Ticker symbol, exact match (e.g. AT, GTCAP)
